## Details

<a id="quit_to_demo"></a>
### [`quit_to_demo`](../../../../src/main/quit_to_demo.asm#L6) `$94AB`

*routine*

Stops the game: removes the sprites, restores the screen and restarts at $800e. The demo starts again.

- **Jumped to from:** [`end_bout`](../combat/end_of_bout.md#end_bout), [`check_attack_contact`](../story/final_stage.md#check_attack_contact), [`check_final_goal`](../story/final_stage.md#check_final_goal), [`read_keys`](../input/keyboard.md#read_keys)
